raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane domain proportions",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 refer to Fig. 1(a) without giving the domain dimensions. The 100×100 element count in Sec. 2.3 does not specify the physical aspect ratio. Let L denote beam span and H its height.",
      "readings": [
        "Square rectangle: L/H = 1",
        "Rectangular domain: L/H = 2",
        "Rectangular domain: L/H = 3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute in-plane length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No physical length units or absolute dimensions are supplied. These alternatives hold aspect ratio, normalized boundary conditions and relative filter length fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit-height nondimensional domain",
        "H = 100 mm, with all geometric lengths scaled together",
        "H = 1 m, with all geometric lengths scaled together"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The cantilever description does not state a thickness or specify that results are per unit thickness.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.01H",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1H"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 fixes 100×100 finite elements but does not describe element interpolation, integration or stabilization; naming top88 does not supply those definitions within the provided text.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2×2 integration",
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with reduced integration and hourglass stabilization",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with full integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Clamped boundary",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The cantilever label identifies a fixed end, but Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 provide no supported edge, segment coordinates or constrained-node set outside Fig. 1(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Both in-plane displacements fixed along the entire left edge",
        "Both in-plane displacements fixed along the entire right edge",
        "Both in-plane displacements fixed on the middle half of the left edge, H/4 ≤ y ≤ 3H/4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied load location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "No load coordinates are given in Secs. 2.1 or 3.1; the boundary-condition description is deferred to Fig. 1(a). Positions below use distance s measured from the clamped end.",
      "readings": [
        "Free-end midpoint: s/L = 1, y/H = 0.5",
        "Lower free-end corner: s/L = 1, y/H = 0",
        "Upper free-end corner: s/L = 1, y/H = 1",
        "Upper boundary at half span: s/L = 0.5, y/H = 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the applied load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The cantilever text does not specify whether the load is concentrated or distributed, or give a loaded boundary length.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one boundary node",
        "Uniform traction over one element edge around the selected location",
        "Uniform traction over the middle 20% of the free edge",
        "Uniform traction over the entire free edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Applied force or traction direction",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The paper identifies constant loading for this problem but gives no force components or direction outside the unavailable schematic.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse downward load",
        "Axial load parallel to the beam span",
        "Load at 45 degrees to the beam span"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall applied-load scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No cantilever force magnitude, resultant traction magnitude or unit-load convention is stated. These alternatives scale the same load pattern uniformly.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant force F = 1 in consistent units",
        "Resultant force F = 100 in consistent units",
        "Resultant force F = 1000 in consistent units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Number, grouping and relative weighting of loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 3.1 do not specify the number of load vectors, whether multiple forces act simultaneously, or whether compliance is aggregated across separate cases.",
      "readings": [
        "One load pattern and one compliance objective",
        "Two simultaneous forces with equal magnitudes",
        "Two simultaneous forces with a magnitude ratio of 2:1",
        "Two separate load cases with an equally weighted sum of compliances"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid or void masks and their volume accounting",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No text specifies whether every grid cell is designable or whether attachment regions are passive; their treatment in the volume budget is also unstated.",
      "readings": [
        "All 10000 elements are designable; no passive regions",
        "One element column at the clamp is fixed solid and counted in the prescribed total volume",
        "A clamp column and load-adjacent element are fixed solid and counted in the prescribed total volume",
        "The same solid attachment regions are excluded from the volume-fraction denominator and budget"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume fraction of the specific Fig. 3(b) target",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 specifies a volume-fraction sweep, and Table 1 labels several individual cases, but neither the text nor the Fig. 3 caption assigns a volume fraction to Fig. 3(b).",
      "readings": [
        "Vf = 0.03",
        "Vf = 0.25",
        "Vf = 0.50",
        "Vf = 0.75"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid Young's modulus or nondimensional stiffness convention is supplied for the cantilever. These alternatives hold Poisson's ratio and the void-to-solid stiffness ratio fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E0 = 1 in nondimensional units",
        "E0 = 70 GPa",
        "E0 = 210 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1–2.3 give no Poisson's ratio for an isotropic elastic interpretation.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.20",
        "nu = 0.30",
        "nu = 0.45"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Elastic constitutive assumptions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The supplied text does not state plane stress versus plane strain or explicitly define the solid constitutive tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress",
        "Isotropic plane strain",
        "Orthotropic plane stress with Ex/Ey = 2, Gxy/Ey = 0.4 and nu_xy = 0.25, with material axes along the beam"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-to-stiffness interpolation and residual void stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 specifies penal = 3 but gives no interpolation equation or residual void modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "E(rho)/E0 = rho^3, with a positive density lower bound",
        "E(rho)/E0 = 1e-9 + (1 - 1e-9)rho^3",
        "E(rho)/E0 = 1e-3 + (1 - 1e-3)rho^3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter operator, kernel and boundary treatment",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 supplies ft = 1 but does not define its action, weights or boundary normalization for implementation in another solver. The numeric flag itself is unambiguous.",
      "readings": [
        "Element-centred sensitivity filtering with linearly decaying weights, normalized over in-domain neighbours",
        "Element-centred density filtering with linearly decaying weights, normalized over in-domain neighbours",
        "Element-centred sensitivity filtering with uniform weights inside the radius",
        "Density filtering with a linear kernel, exterior void padding and full-kernel normalization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and distance metric of the filter radius",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The value rmin = 2.4 is explicit in Sec. 2.3, but its units and distance convention are not defined, particularly if horizontal and vertical cell sizes differ.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius 2.4 measured by Euclidean distance in element-index coordinates",
        "Physical circular radius equal to 2.4 horizontal element widths",
        "Physical circular radius equal to 2.4 vertical element heights",
        "Radius 2.4 in the geometric coordinate units of the domain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Design-density lower bound",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The cantilever setup gives no minimum admissible element density; this is distinct from the residual stiffness assigned to void.",
      "readings": [
        "0 ≤ rho ≤ 1",
        "0.001 ≤ rho ≤ 1",
        "0.01 ≤ rho ≤ 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 does not state how each cantilever optimization is initialized or whether successive volume fractions reuse previous solutions.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every designable element at rho = Vf",
        "Initialize every designable element at rho = 1",
        "Warm-start each volume fraction from the preceding optimized design",
        "Initialize with small feasible nonuniform perturbations around Vf"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization update method and move limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "top88 is named, but the provided text does not describe its optimization update or numerical controls for reproducing the run in another solver.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with maximum density move 0.2 per iteration",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with maximum density move 0.05 per iteration",
        "MMA updates with maximum density move 0.2 per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Cantilever stopping criteria and iteration cap",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No convergence tolerance or iteration cap is supplied for the cantilever. The maxit = 100 setting in Sec. 2.3 belongs to TOPress for the arch.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at maximum element-density change below 0.01, capped at 1000 iterations",
        "Stop at maximum element-density change below 0.001, capped at 1000 iterations",
        "Stop at relative compliance change below 1e-5, capped at 200 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
